recorded_on_semantics.asserts: 本 manifest 在该时区的该自然日建立。
does_not_assert: 与同日其他文件或事件的先后顺序
先于仓库历史中任何一次结果暴露

supersession_scope: 逐 curve_scope 冻结在 point filtering/grid 前以全部 finite scored supported pixels 的原始 risk_proxy 计算 s_min、s_max、score_range；不舍入，且 min/max 前不合并 bit-exact tie records；score_range<=tau_score 为 score degeneracy。
冻结 fixed-grid 完整 piecewise：J=0 全 below；J>0 时 q<c1 为 below、q>cJ 为 above、区间内取 j*=max{j:cj<=q}，且 q=cJ reachable；保留 smallest-q canonical、duplicate 与 null 字段规则。
将 canonical coverage 字段统一为 selective_prediction_coverage，短名只允许显式逐值 alias，并同步整数乘积恒等式。
将 partition 改为无条件 sum_h(stratum_scoring_coverage_h)=unit_all.scoring_coverage；仅存在 terminal admissible point 的 h 可断言 max_selective_prediction_coverage_h=S_h/D，否则为 null 且不进入 max 等式。
科研 verdict 改为逐 curve_scope 产生：unit_all_scored 为 primary，三个 supported-stratum scopes 为 secondary；禁止合成 unit/node verdict，并按 band x curve_scope x PF3 verdict 计数且保留 not-evaluable reason。
将 v2 过宽的 protocol_error 范围修正为 core 内 base_valid_land 的 cos_i missing/nonfinite/outside[-1,1] 与 supported residual nonfinite；core 外和非 base-valid 像元不因本协议报错。
显式登记 v1->v2->v3 的全部 material drift，包括 M1 all-exact 到 all-admissible、out-of-domain、curve scopes、coverage、verdict、tolerance、fixed-grid 与 v3 reply token；只保留三方案身份与 M2 推荐，不声称完整 pack 定义未变。
inherited_without_change: 高层 option A 的 PF3 批准回执与有限授权边界
method pack 无法由冻结上游唯一编译的结果盲审计结论
v1-v5 predecessor chain 中全部未被本 supersession scope 替换的事实
supersession.authoritative_reading: v1-v5 保留为不可改写的历史证据；method-pack 候选定义与 activation 阻塞字段以 v6 及其绑定的 decision request v3 为准。

cos_i outside[-1,1] protocol-error condition added, but with an over-broad core-wide domain corrected in v3
M1 verdict sequence corrected from all exact points to all admissible exact points
named curve scopes introduced; M1 retained unit_all only while M2/M3 added three stratum scopes
single residual tolerance split into tau_score and tau_outcome; one-DN M3 tolerance limited to outcome
curve_shape separated from five-state PF3 risk_proxy_verdict with two not-evaluable classes
fixed-grid record/canonical/unreachable/rational rules and explicit AURC J/span/domain added
v2_to_v3: raw per-scope pre-filter score-range computation and degeneracy predicate frozen
protocol-error domain narrowed from all core cos_i to core base_valid_land cos_i, while retaining outside[-1,1]
selective_prediction_coverage made the canonical field and aliases constrained
fixed-grid J=0 and lower/interior/upper piecewise mapping completed
unconditional scoring partition separated from conditional terminal max-selective identity

categorical aggregation key and not-evaluable reason retention frozen; owner reply token advanced to v3

unique_compilation_audit.question: 在高层 option A 已批准后，完整 method pack 是否能由冻结上游无自由选择地唯一编译？
unique_compilation_audit.witness: M1/M2/M3 v3 均遵守高层 A 与冻结上游且不读取结果，却选择不同 grid、support guard、tolerance、verdict sequence 与 AURC 约定。

protocol_error_domain.cos_i: core 内 base_valid_land 像元 missing/nonfinite/outside[-1,1]
protocol_error_domain.out_of_scope: core 外或 core 内非 base_valid_land 像元不因本协议报错

score_range.population: all finite scored supported pixels in that scope
score_range.stage: before accepted-point filtering and fixed-grid mapping
preprocessing_forbidden: collapsing bit-exact tie records before min/max

coverage_semantics.core_total_pixel_count: 冻结 core footprint 内该 unit 的全部机会像元；为零即 protocol_error。
coverage_semantics.allowed_short_alias: selective_coverage only with explicit alias_of and exact value/null equality
coverage_semantics.zero_denominators: T=0 protocol_error; D=0 typed not_scored; S=0 insufficient support with acceptance_given_scored null

partition.terminal_condition: only when h has a terminal admissible point with A_terminal=S_h
partition.without_terminal: max_selective_prediction_coverage_h=null and h excluded from every max-selective identity

piecewise: J=0: all q unreachable with below_min_accepted_support
J>0 and q<c1: unreachable with below_min_accepted_support
J>0 and q>cJ: unreachable with above_max_reachable_coverage
c1<=q<=cJ: j*=max{j:cj<=q}; q=cJ maps to J
fixed_grid.comparison: q=k/m and cj=Aj/D compared only by integer cross multiplication m*Aj<=k*D
fixed_grid.canonical: among q mapping to the same j*, smallest q is the sole reachable and canonical_target_q=target_q
fixed_grid.duplicate: keeps exact index and selective_prediction_coverage; reason=duplicate_exact_point; canonical_target_q points to smallest q

scope_local_verdict.aggregation_key: band x curve_scope x PF3 risk_proxy_verdict

method_pack_review_constraints.tolerance_separation: 每包独立冻结 tau_score 与 tau_outcome；M3 的一个 SR DN 只适用于 outcome delta，绝不适用于 dimensionless proxy score。
method_pack_review_constraints.M2_guard_if_approved: scope-level N_scored>=271 AND every verdict/AURC admissible exact point accepted_n>=271; q maps admissible points only; 271 is governance, not statistical independence.
method_pack_review_constraints.AURC_domain_if_approved: [c_start,c_max] only; report span; never extrapolate from zero or to one; use each pack's v3 formula.

open_gaps.finding: 高层 A 回执没有覆盖 v3 中 M1/M2/M3 的完整实质参数；执行者无权代选。
open_gaps.required_owner_action: 以 accepted_reply_closed_set 中的精确 v3 文本明确批准且只批准一个 method pack，并取得新的稳定回执。

result_blind_audit.audit_scope: 只修复并审计 method-pack decision request v3 与 activation preflight v6；不评价任何 pack 对既有结果的表现。
result_blind_audit.scope_caveat: 这是本次审计窗口的读取与执行声明，不声称抹除仓库历史或其他执行者的既有暴露。
